newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - Russian still trickles out.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - Russian still trickles out.

text.p: Russian straight-run material continues to trickle through, but despite crude regaining strength E-4s were having trouble finding buyers interested in material above $130 cif NWE.

The low sulphur straight-run sector remained quiet with prices pegged in the mid to high $140s fob NWE. A seller of a cargo that needs to be lifted before December 20 appeared relaxed and there were no signs of levels easing.
"There's no incentive if you're not under pressure to lower prices when crude is behaving like this," said one trader.
